structured_output.notes: All tests and smoke scripts use only the Python 3 standard library (unittest, tempfile, urllib.request, sqlite3, threading, json, os, sys, pathlib). Each test case dynamically manages server lifecycle on ephemeral ports (port=0) with isolated temporary SQLite databases, ensuring thread-safe concurrency and no port or file locks. Clean teardowns guarantee complete resource release.
structured_output.summary: Implemented comprehensive Python 3 standard library unit/integration tests in tests/test_api.py, persistence verification in tests/test_persistence.py, and a standalone 12-step deterministic end-to-end smoke verification script in scripts/smoke_test.py.
